findings.summary: CODEX-03-A is accepted against architecture v1.2 (SHA-256 02adc2e0…532b79), ADR-E02 and the approved F04 card. All three acceptance criteria have real evidence. (1) Switching household or sibling never shows another scope or stale private data. The server enforces the current consent-locked scope and a non-authorizing view context checked before any callback. The UI uses generation guards, and real HTTP/React tests plus native runs cover held late responses, account switching, withdrawal, re-consent and session expiry. (2) The empty state opens a real, labelled, unsent in-memory wonder textarea. Ready and paused work opens the exact immutable revision introduction or the acknowledged resume receipt; the original-source pin and pending-journal hiding are proven by the protected PGlite/journal probe. (3) Saved-only, received, accepted, ready, closed and overdue requests are shown as distinct states. The trial period and allowance are projected from real kernel claims, with expiry and full-quota copy that invents no policy. Controller evidence is attached for the exact candidate: 68/68 app tests, build, all protected probes, 76 route identities, a seeded private-content scan, and an eight-scenario native CUA run on commit 264a3d2 including the link-only LoopChildSetup regression. Three things remain open: persistence and Start are named downstream interfaces for 04-A, 04-B, 04-C and 08-A, not claimed done, and no policy or privacy gate is resolved. What I read: AGENTS, SOURCE_OF_TRUTH, GOVERNANCE and APPROVALS in full; PRODUCT_V1 v0.4.1 in full; the engineering README, ENGINEERING_DESIGN_V1, MODULE_GUIDE and REVIEW_NOTES in full; PROJECT_CONTEXT v1.95 lines 1–1309 in full, in four large chunks rather than 40-line sections, with no truncation; the approved 03-A card; the protected family probe; the play-service resume/reconcile code; the adult-http body guard; the TASKS.json dependents of 03-A; and the 00-C F04 row. I did not read PRODUCT_DECISIONS, WORK_MODULES_V1 or the 00-B CONTRACTS file.

findings.title: Completion record omits direct downstream dependents 03-C, 09-B, 09-C
findings.problem: The card's completion section requires recording 'downstream IDs from the index'. The open-interface list covers 04-A, 04-B, 04-C and 08-A. In TASKS.json, CODEX-03-C (trial-ended/help and paid continuation), CODEX-09-B (parent feedback) and CODEX-09-C (starting-level selection) also depend directly on CODEX-03-A, and none of them is listed. 03-C is most relevant, because 03-A already shows factual 'Trial ended' copy that 03-C must extend without contradicting it. This is a recording gap, not a missing acceptance criterion.
findings.fix_check: The acceptance/completion record and FAMILY_SPACE_CONTRACT open-downstream section list CODEX-03-C, 04-A, 09-B and 09-C as direct dependents, alongside the 04-B, 04-C and 08-A interface consumers, without claiming any of them is complete.

findings.title: REPORT and contract still say checks/native/review are pending
findings.problem: FAMILY_SPACE_CONTRACT.md line 3 says 'Awaiting actual checks, full native evidence and independent feature review', and its verification paragraph calls the evidence 'preliminary'. REPORT.md paragraph 2 says 'None is claimed passed yet', and its final paragraph says native scenarios and the Claude verdict are 'still pending'. The attached controller log and the CUA record for 264a3d2 supersede these statements. Left in an app-repo doc after merge, they would misstate the evidence record, contrary to the AGENTS.md rule to record results accurately.
findings.fix_check: At acceptance, the controller's completion record cites the 68/68 run, build, card checker, the 8-scenario CUA on 264a3d2 and this review. The app-repo contract header no longer claims checks are pending, or is explicitly dated as historical.

findings.title: Test failure diagnostic regex matches the probe filename, not this test
findings.problem: The catch block extracts a line number with /family_space_probe\.mjs:(\d+)/, copied from the protected probe. The test file is loop-family-space.test.mjs, so every failure reports 'unknown-line', and because stdout/stderr are swallowed the real assertion location is lost. This does not affect pass/fail correctness, only debugging.
findings.fix_check: The regex matches loop-family-space\.test\.mjs, or another sanitized locator, so a deliberately failed assertion reports its line.

findings.title: A poll or focus during an open silently discards the opened investigation
findings.problem: refresh() increments openSequence, so a 15-second poll, focus or pageshow recheck that lands while an open request is in flight drops its result with no notice. The parent clicked 'Open…' and sees nothing. The contract intends to invalidate old opens; the UX gap is the missing honest retry message.
findings.fix_check: When a same-context recheck invalidates an in-flight open, the UI either re-issues the open after confirming scope or shows a status asking the parent to retry, with no stale entry displayed.
